firmware.note: The PicoFox runs the vendor's own Arduino firmware (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), not CircuitPython. fox-bench only writes the files that firmware reads. The firmware itself is fetched from the vendor's GitHub into your browser when you ask for it; nothing of it is hosted here.

stock_firmware_files.name: pfoxr3v1.uf2
stock_firmware_files.note: the vendor firmware (rev 2 and rev 3 boards; it detects the revision)

stock_firmware_files.name: pfoxr3-forceformat.uf2
stock_firmware_files.note: recovery only: reformats the drive at EVERY boot, so files written to it vanish at the next power cycle and the fox stays silent. Use it to wipe a corrupt volume, then flash pfoxr3v1 before writing any files.

drive.label: PicoFox
drive.note: The fox does not transmit while a computer has the drive mounted. After writing: eject the drive, then switch the PicoFox off and on.
